script.onScreen: Friday has a pause in it. / One ayah. One lesson.

REFLECTION / The lesson / The first ayah asks believers to leave trade and proceed to the remembrance of Allah at the Friday call. The next sends them back out, remembering Him often. Friday is a pause in the middle of life, not a break from it.
THIS FRIDAY / Clear your schedule before the call comes · Leave the phone and the work for later · Go back to your day with dhikr on your tongue
Pause. Remember. Return. / Save this for next Friday

caption:
Jumu'ah Mubarak.

Al-Jumu'ah 62:9, then the ayah after it (62:10): stop for the remembrance of Allah, then go back out remembering Him often.

Swipe for the ayat and three small ways to keep the pause.

Save this for next Friday.

sources.english: O you who have believed, when [the adhan] is called for the prayer on the day of Jumu'ah [Friday], then proceed to the remembrance of Allah and leave trade. That is better for you, if you only knew
And when the prayer has been concluded, disperse within the land and seek from the bounty of Allah, and remember Allah often that you may succeed
